task_due.name: task_due
task_due.where: deleted_at IS NULL AND completed_at IS NULL

task_recurrence_basis.name: task_recurrence_basis
task_recurrence_basis.value: recurrence_basis IS NULL OR recurrence_basis IN ('due','completion')

task_due_time_needs_date.name: task_due_time_needs_date
task_due_time_needs_date.value: due_time IS NULL OR due_date IS NOT NULL

task_start_before_due.name: task_start_before_due
task_start_before_due.value: start_date IS NULL OR due_date IS NULL OR start_date <= due_date
